I am 73, been farming this land 50 years. My son works in town now, just me and my wife at home. 4.1 mu is not much but it feeds us and we sell some.

I do wheat-maize like everyone here in Quzhou. Everyone does it this way, so I do too. Last year wheat gave me about 450 kg per mu, maize maybe 550 kg. Not bad, not great.

For wheat I plant in October. I use the improved seed from the agro-shop in town — the dealer sells what works here, my neighbor Old Wang used the same and got good wheat. I buy two bags of compound fertilizer (the 15-15-15 kind) per mu before planting, that is 50 kg, plus one bag of urea for topdressing in spring when the wheat gets green again, about 20 kg. My wife helps spread it. I plough before wheat because the ground gets hard. I water maybe 3 times — before winter, at jointing, and at filling. Well water is there but the electricity costs money so I don't waste it.

For maize I plant right after wheat harvest in June, no tillage, just drill into the stubble. Saves time and diesel. I use hybrid seed, the Zhengdan kind my neighbors plant. Maize eats more fertilizer than wheat — I put one bag compound at planting (25 kg) and then two times urea topdressing, maybe 30 kg total. Maize wants water at tasseling, so I irrigate 2 times if no rain, sometimes only once if summer rain comes.

Pesticide — wheat gets aphids in spring, I spray once. Sometimes powdery mildew, spray again, so 2 times. Maize I spray once for borer, maybe twice if bugs are bad.

I don't want to cut fertilizer. If I save 50 yuan on fertilizer and lose 100 kg of grain, that is stupid. Better to put enough.
